verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents custom dashboards for cost, latency, volume, and quality (eval scores) [docs-38], and dashboards that monitor cost across models, tags, or users [docs-33]. A Metrics API v2 also queries aggregate cost, latency, and score metrics for custom views [docs-15]. missing for 10: explicit evidence that error/failure-rate metrics can be charted, in-depth docs on dashboard building (widgets, filters, breakdowns), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard feature.
